_about: The trailer's captions (site-src/PAGES.md, "The trailer"): one cue per line shown, with its start and end in seconds from the start of the trailer, and its words in English. Every "text" is translated in site_tr.py's Home block like any other phrase (keys_all.py lists them); the build writes /video/captions-<lang>.vtt for all 9 languages and a <track> for each beside the video. While the list is empty, no captions are made.
